result.description:
## Network Administrator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Network Administrator to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and security of our organisation's network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in network administration, a methodical approach to troubleshooting, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly across all levels of the business. This role suits a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to delivering reliable, efficient IT services.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain network hardware, software, servers, and workstations, ensuring systems are kept up to date and performing optimally
- Monitor network performance on an ongoing basis, identifying and resolving issues proactively to minimise disruption to business operations
- Diagnose and troubleshoot network faults, emergencies, and connectivity issues, documenting resolutions and maintaining accurate records of all incidents and modifications
- Develop, maintain, and update procedures and documentation for network inventory, configuration changes, and maintenance instructions
- Manage user accounts, access permissions, and password policies in line with the organisation's security standards and compliance requirements
- Provide network programming and scripting support to address specific business needs and improve the efficiency of network operations
- Administer and support servers, printers, and personal computers, ensuring hardware resources remain reliable and fit for purpose
- Evaluate and implement upgrades to network infrastructure, recommending improvements that align with business growth and evolving technology requirements
- Deliver helpdesk support and technical assistance to end users, resolving issues in a timely manner and escalating complex problems where necessary
- Conduct user training and produce clear guidance materials to build internal capability and promote best practice use of network systems
- Maintain network security protocols, including firewall management, intrusion detection, and vulnerability assessments, to safeguard organisational data and systems
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to coordinate service delivery, procurement, and project implementation
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Proven experience in a network administration or systems administration role within a corporate or enterprise environment
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, infrastructure components, and technologies including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, and firewalls
- Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, and managing servers, switches, routers, and associated network hardware
- Proficiency in network monitoring and diagnostic tools, with the ability to analyse performance data and respond to anomalies
- Solid understanding of network security principles, including access control, patch management, and risk mitigation
- Experience maintaining technical documentation, network inventories, and fault resolution records to a high standard
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work methodically under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or equivalent
- Experience with virtualisation platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure and hybrid network environments
- Experience working within ITIL frameworks or other structured IT service management methodologies
- Exposure to scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Ansible to streamline network operations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive, forward-thinking team that values continuous learning and invests in your professional development through training and certification opportunities
- Enjoy genuine flexibility with a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance
- Work on diverse and challenging infrastructure projects that will broaden your technical expertise and keep your skills at the cutting edge
- Join an organisation with a strong culture of collaboration, where your contributions are recognised and your ideas are encouraged
- Competitive remuneration package with long-term career pathways and opportunities for progression within a growing business
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

Queensland Cotton Corporation has been pivotal in the Australian cotton through their involvement and contribution locally, but also through supplying premium cotton to the world’s textile markets. Their reputation as a leading cotton corporation has remained true for decades. From cotton ginning, marketing through to warehousing and exporting, our client is trusted by farmers and customers across Australia to produce and supply superior and consistent quality cotton.

Your Role

We are currently seeking for experienced Mechanical Engineering Technicians to join our busy Cotton Ginning operations located in Emerald, Cecil Plains, Moura and Dalby, QLD. During the season, working on a shift roster, you will be involved in all aspects of ginning operations, including monitoring production, troubleshooting and repairing mechanical issues to improve Gin productivity. You will also be doing the preventative maintenance on Gin machinery and equipment.

You will be responsible for (but not be limited to):

* Performing Gin checks with the specifications and machines settings, to make sure the cotton gin running at optimal levels.
* Diagnosing and resolving breakdowns of ginning equipment promptly to ensure downtime is minimised.
* Monitoring downtime statistics and troubleshoot problems.
* Carrying out necessary repairs and maintenance per the agreed schedule.
* Changing or fitting hydraulic hoses.
* Review parts inventory.
* Help to maintain good plant hygiene and support general maintenance activities.
* Ensure safe systems of work and adhere to the company’s safety management system.

About you

To be considered for this position, you will need to prove the following:

* Mechanical trade qualification and certificate, or employment experience in lieu
* Minimum 2 years relevant work experience, ideally in cotton ginning.
* Previous maintenance and mechanical experience.
* Exposure to managing a diverse team or shift in remote or isolated environment.
* Reasonable computer skills, high levels of literacy to understand safety instructions and good communication skills to work effectively as part of a team.
* Understanding of hydraulic system.
* Knowledge of Australia’s work Health and Safety requirements is ideal.
* Fitness to be able to manage long shifts during the season.
* Great work ethic, eager to learn and able to think on your feet to troubleshoot.
* Respectful and able to interact with people from diverse cultures.
* Valid driver license.
* For the right candidate, the annual salary package of $80,000 - $95,000 + super is on offer.

About Us

Queensland Cotton Corporation has been going strong for 100 years, supplying premium cotton to the world's textile markets. We are a wholly owned subsidiary of Olam Agri, a leading global food and agri-business.

Working within a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will play a key role in the design, development and integration of complex products and systems throughout the engineering lifecycle.

 Develop and maintain mechanical designs, engineering drawings and technical documentation.

 Ensure designs meet customer, safety, regulatory and compliance requirements. 
 Support prototype, testing, verification and validation activities as required.

 Degree qualified in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

 Understanding of engineering lifecycles, design reviews and configuration management processes. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

  Desirable  
   
   
 
 Experience working on Defence programs. 
 Understanding of systems engineering principles. 
 Exposure to AS9100, ISO9001 or similar quality standards. 
 Eligibility to obtain and maintain an Australian Defence Security Clearance.

 12-month contract with extension potential.

 Opportunity to work on a major Defence capability program.

Defence Sector | Melbourne or Bendigo | Secure Programs  Join a leading defence organisation delivering advanced engineering solutions across complex land platforms. Operating within a highly secure environment, this organisation is recognised for developing cutting-edge vehicle and hardware systems that support critical national capability.    Your new role     
 This is a unique opportunity for a CAD / Hardware Design Engineer to contribute across the full design lifecycle, combining hands-on 3D CAD expertise with broader hardware engineering and integration exposure. 
 You will play a key role in the design, development, and validation of components and systems for complex land platforms, supporting both prototype and production environments. 
 
 Develop high-quality 3D CAD models and detailed drawings using Creo Parametric 
 Design and validate mechanical and electrical components and subsystems for complex vehicle platforms 
 Produce and maintain engineering documentation in line with standards and regulatory requirements 
 Conduct tolerance analysis and support design optimisation to ensure manufacturability and performance 
 Support prototyping, integration, testing, and validation activities 
 Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to deliver integrated design solutions 
 Manage CAD data, drawings, and configurations within PLM systems (e.g. Windchill) 
 Ensure compliance with engineering standards, export controls, and security requirements 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Degree, diploma, or equivalent in Engineering or a related discipline 
 Proven experience in 3D CAD design (Creo Parametric preferred) 
 Experience in design and manufacturing environments (defence, automotive, or heavy vehicles advantageous) 
 Strong understanding of engineering drawings, materials, and design principles 
 Experience with tolerance analysis and design validation 
 Work on highly secure, nationally significant defence programs 
 Exposure to advanced engineering and vehicle design technologies 
 Collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering environment 
 Strong long-term career pathways within the defence sector 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Work on highly secure, nationally significant defence programs 
 Exposure to advanced engineering and vehicle design technologies 
 Collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering environment 
 Strong long-term career pathways within the defence sector 
 Attractive Daily Rates

Please  click here  to apply.

Philip Riley are looking for a Computer Network and System Engineer to join our team.

Responsibilities include:

· Design, develop and install new and efficient network and systems architecture, applications, databases and servers

· Evaluate and provide recommendations on ways network and system operations and hardware can be improved and optimised

· Consistently monitor network and system activities, capacities and usage to maintain reliability and optimise performance for users

· Rectify network problems and emergencies in a professional, skilled and timely manner

· Offer network programming which will support the needs and requirements to meet organisational specifications

· Analyse, configure and monitor network infrastructure to ensure networks and systems are operating effectively and at a high level of performance.

· Ensure appropriate procedures and documentation methods are in place to record network inventory, problems and their resolutions, any updates or modifications, and instructions on maintaining a business's technical networks and systems.

· Assist and provide recommendations on the development, integration and installation of systems and networks by analysing and evaluating system and network designs, architecture requirements, models and diagrams.

· monitoring network traffic, and activity, capacity and usage to ensure continued integrity and optimal network performance

As successful candidate will be able to design, develop, maintain, configure and provide support for network and system hardware. They will be required to investigate, analyse, test and make recommendations to users regarding opportunities and strategies to optimise technical networks and systems.

The successful candidate will have:

-A minimum of 1 years experience in the field

-Excellent verbal and written communication skills the ability to prioritize and successfully complete projects.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $87,500.00 – $107,500.00 per year + super annuation


Work Location: In person

result.description:
About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer with strong experience to join our growing team and contribute to the development that empowers our organization to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Apply your expertise, technical acumen, and leadership skills to drive innovation and make a significant impact on our business growth.

Key Responsibilities Include:
Design and maintain Automation framework and scripts
Maintain and enhance test automation frameworks using programming languages (Java/Python/JavaScript).
Responsible for creation and implementation of test strategy, test plans, test data for testing.
Conducting and scheduling regression testing using CI/CD pipelines and documenting the results.
Reviewing requirements with Business Analysts and Technical leads
Involve with business and development teams to understand the requirements.
Review design documents for new features and participate in design reviews with the development team.
Involve in Client Engagements to understand the testing scope of the product and release
Preparing Test data by clearly analysing the requirements
Involve in Sprint Backlog refinements / grooming and planning sessions
Developing scenarios and executing automation scripts using automation framework
Implementing and maintaining regression test suite which saves the time for regression testing
Conducting demos to the stakeholders after completing the user stories
Preparation of Test Completion Report, Defect Analysis Report and share with stakeholders

Candidate Qualification:
5 years of experience in software testing as Automation and Functional tester.
Expertise in designing test scripts using Selenium Maven TestNG , Playwright, Cucumber and Rest Assured framework.
Experience in developing test plans, test cases, test data and test reports.
Experience in functional testing, User Acceptance Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, UI Automation Testing using Java-selenium and Web service Automation using Cucumber and TestNG framework
Extensive experience in SDLC and Agile Process
Designing test cases and test scenarios, conducted functional, ad-hoc and exploratory testing for the variety of applications with expanded test coverage
Experience in working with GitHub as source code management tools
Experience in Bug tracking Tools like JIRA
Effective time management skills – prioritization of tasks and own time by regular follow- up meetings
Ability to remain highly focused and self-motivated in a fast-paced, demand environment.
Critical thinking and analytical skills
Good communication and teamwork skills

Next Steps
If you would like to express interest in the role, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: From $90,000 - $110,000 AUD per annum plus Superannuation
